features.name: Expense management agent
features.description: An AI feature that was developed completely using AI and released in a very short period of time. The expense agent was written approximately 90 percent by AI with a development timeline from idea to release of about 6 months.
features.status_evidence_quote: when it's released in the wild when people start using it
caveats: adoption timeline uncertain
real-world effectiveness needs validation

features.name: BC quality workflow with agenting and code review
features.description: A new workflow for development that includes agenting triage, code review, and AI-assisted processes. It incorporates both Microsoft community instructions and allows partners to add their own custom instructions for code monitoring.
caveats: requires understanding of AI behavior
partner adoption may take time
proper testing still required
not suitable for all scenarios

features.name: GitHub Copilot
features.description: An AI tool being used for development work, currently employed by developers for developing partner projects and other development efforts.

features.name: Cloud Code
features.description: An AI development tool that developers have experimented with alongside GitHub Copilot for development work.

features.name: GitHub Copilot for AL development
features.description: Developers using GitHub Copilot for writing AL code in Business Central extensions and projects. One developer reports 95% of code generated by Copilot, achieving less buggy results than manual coding.
caveats: Requires MVP access to Pro Plus version for professional credits
Effectiveness depends on proper requirements writing

features.name: Multi-agent workflow for development
features.description: Framework using multiple specialized agents for different development phases: planning agent, working agent, and reviewing agent. Developers can assign different tasks to different models and consolidate results.
caveats: Requires manual review of generated code before submission
Token consumption is high when switching between models

features.name: Gamified AL training approach
features.description: Game-based learning methodology discussed at conference for teaching AL development practices. Involves creating game mechanics to reinforce development patterns and best practices.
caveats: Emerging practice, not yet widely implemented

features.name: Instruction files and sub-agents for Copilot
features.description: Advanced Copilot features including instruction files, sub-agents, and skills to customize and specialize agent behavior. Recommended to start without these and learn basics first.
caveats: Learning curve requires understanding basic Copilot functionality first
Can be overwhelming for new users

features.name: Automated screenshot generation with Playwright
features.description: Using Playwright and page scripting to automatically generate screenshots and documentation. Enables agents to autonomously create user guides with visual examples from interface interactions.
caveats: Manual fine-tuning still needed for 100% accuracy
Requires page scripting knowledge

features.name: Agent-driven documentation generation
features.description: Using AI agents to automatically generate user documentation including detailed step-by-step guides. Results are typically 90% complete and require minor adjustments by humans.
caveats: May require 10% adjustment for complete accuracy

features.name: Professional credits token allocation
features.description: MVP access to GitHub Copilot Pro Plus version includes professional credits for token consumption across multiple projects and reasoning models.
caveats: Credits are consumed quickly when switching between models

features.name: AI assistance for RDL report creation
features.description: AI can create RDL formatted reports with reasonable quality, leveraging the HTML-like structure of RDL format.
caveats: RDL conversion success rate approximately 60-70%
Mapping fields in Word layouts has not been successfully completed yet
Produces RDL that sometimes cannot be compiled

features.name: AI assistance for Word layout design
features.description: AI can create visually appealing Word layouts for invoices and other documents when provided with sample data and requirements, but field mapping remains incomplete.
caveats: Field mapping is the trickier part and not yet fully functional
Workflow for Word layout generation is incomplete
Requires significant manual finishing work beyond AI generation

features.name: Microsoft shift from RDLC to Word layouts
features.description: Microsoft is changing the direction to move standard customer-facing documents from RDLC layout format to Word layout format.
caveats: Hard cut not yet complete, transition is ongoing
RDLC will continue to be supported alongside Word layouts

features.name: RDLC layout continued support
features.description: RDLC reports will continue to work and can still be created, though Microsoft is not actively improving the technology as it's managed by a different team.
caveats: RDLC maintenance is not a Business Central team responsibility
No active improvements planned for RDLC technology
Likely to be phased out over time as technology advances

features.name: AI-powered performance analysis for profiler data
features.description: AI tools can analyze performance profiler data and telemetry to identify non-performant code and suggest improvements without requiring manual analysis.
caveats: Still requires exploration and testing
Multiple initiatives underway but not yet fully mature

features.name: MCP integration for telemetry log analysis
features.description: Ability to read telemetry logs through MCP without requiring manual KQL queries, enabling faster analysis of performance data.
caveats: Speaker plans to set up next week, indicating early adoption phase
Not yet widely used across the partner community

features.name: XRechnung and ZUGFeRD e-invoice support
features.description: Support for German electronic invoice exchange formats (XRechnung and ZUGFeRD) with fixes related to local format application.
caveats: Specific to German market implementation

features.name: Telemetry analysis through MCP
features.description: Using AI-powered Model Context Protocol to read telemetry logs without needing KQL expertise, enabling easier performance analysis and issue identification.
caveats: Still being implemented
Requires proper dashboard and query setup

features.name: AI-powered proactive telemetry monitoring
features.description: Using AI agents to analyze telemetry patterns, identify performance issues, detect non-performant code, and automatically create GitHub issues for action without manual review.
caveats: Currently manual process
Requires proper AI setup and integration

features.name: Telemetry for code refactoring identification
features.description: Using telemetry data to proactively identify code that needs refactoring, improvements, and other optimization opportunities for internal development teams and partners.
caveats: Requires proper telemetry collection
Many partners not yet utilizing this capability

features.name: AI development assistants (Claude, GitHub Copilot, Gemini)
features.description: Multiple AI tools available for developers including Claude Web App and Code, GitHub Copilot, and Gemini for writing code, documentation, and non-development tasks.
caveats: Requires subscriptions
Quality varies by tool and use case

features.name: AI agents creating custom languages for efficiency
features.description: Future capability where AI agents may create their own optimized languages for inter-agent communication when human languages become inefficient, as observed in recent research.
caveats: Based on external research, not Business Central specific
Speculative for business applications
